  "cons": [
    "Noted that advanced features, potentially useful for future growth, seemed to be locked behind higher-tier, more costly plans.",
    "Felt that fully understanding and configuring all aspects of the system required a significant time investment.",
    "Encountered some frustration with the reporting features, finding the data less digestible than expected."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This self-employed student found Freshdesk to be an intuitive platform for managing customer service interactions during their free trial. They valued its potential to streamline communications and appreciated the initial ease of use for core functions. However, the reviewer anticipated that the product could become costly for a growing business, and noted that a deeper understanding of its advanced features and reporting capabilities would require a substantial time commitment."
